newsitem.title: USA: Goulds says Q1 gross margins declined.
newsitem.headline: Goulds says Q1 gross margins declined.

text.p: Goulds Pumps Inc said Thursday its first quarter gross margin dropped to 28.2 percent compared to 29.1 percent the year-ago quarter, due to lower sales and the consequently less favorable absorption of overhead.
Chairman Thomas McDermott said the company sees the gross margin decline as a "quarterly issue."
McDermott said he "continues to be confident that 1997 will again be a very good, record-setting year for Goulds..."
Goulds reported first quarter earnings of $8 million, or $0.38 per share, up from $7.2 million, or $0.34 a share, a year earlier.
